headline: Irisalis build
title: Irisalis Best Build | Attack Then Regen | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Irisalis is a Grass damage dealer, and her build is simple. Put your awakening points into Attack first, then Regen. Break comes after that if you have spare resources. Her signature held item is the Floral Rainbow Feather, which works with her clones, and it needs thirty Irisalis Petals. Keep her clones up and use her ultimate whenever it is ready. Do you run her with Leafy? Comment below!
description: Irisalis best build in Aniimo (checked Nov 2026): Grass damage dealer, awakening priority Attack then Regen then Break, Floral Rainbow Feather held item (thirty Irisalis Petals), keep clones active.
